verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS billing platform's source is available under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents official client libraries, mobile SDKs and an MCP server, but none of it says Recurly's own source is published under an open license. Client libraries are developer building blocks rather than the product's source, and no license terms are cited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
